description: OpenCode v2 plugin: when a session dies on a provider rate/quota limit (HTTP 429 etc.), wait until the plan's quota window resets, then automatically re-prompt the session to continue on the same subscription model.

detail.description_zh: OpenCode v2 插件：当提供商达到速率/配额限制（HTTP 429 等）时，等待计划的配额窗口重置，然后自动重新提示会话以在同一订阅模式下继续。
